scope: Additional named-section and standardisation leads from Korean, Argentine and Philippine authority or research sources. These are research records, not implemented geometry.

records.organisation: Korea Expressway Corporation Road Traffic Research Institute
records.title_original: PSC I 거더교의 최적설계 및 표준화 연구
records.title_en: Optimum design and standardisation study of PSC I-girder bridges
records.locator: CODIL record, 2005 report; authors Park Young-ha, Park Min-seok, Gil Hong-bae, Lee Yong-gu and Yoo Ho-in; original PDF link on record
records.printed_dimensions: The indexed authority record identifies a dedicated PSC I-girder optimum-design and standardisation report; section dimensions were not accessible during this pass.
records.missing_information: Retrieve the linked Korean PDF, translate the type schedule and inspect the complete standard contours. Determine which sizes are adopted highway products rather than study-only alternatives.

records.organisation: Korea Construction Infrastructure Technology / CODIL drawing archive
records.title_original: TENDON WORK OF PSC I-GIRDER BRIDGE
records.title_en: Tendon work drawing for a 30 m PSC I-girder bridge
records.locator: Drawing ID SD 1999-24-30-9; archive text gives girder geometry and end/centre tendon sections
records.printed_dimensions: Indexed drawing record gives 30 m girder length, 200 cm depth, 70 cm upper flange, 66 cm lower flange and four tendons of 12 strands of 12.7 mm; full web, haunch and chamfer dimensions remain unverified.
records.missing_information: Retrieve the original sheet, visually transcribe the complete concrete outline and compare it with Korean standardisation families. The indexed dimensions alone are insufficient for a polygon.
records.contact_route: CODIL original drawing archive, drawing SD 1999-24-30-9

records.organisation: Argentinian Road and Traffic Congress, Group 4
records.title_original: Puentes de vigas premoldeadas de hormigón pretensado
records.title_en: Bridges consisting of premoulded prestressed concrete beams
records.locator: Seventh Argentinian Road and Traffic Congress, Group 4, Report 164, pp. 303–318, December 1972; TRID abstract
records.printed_dimensions: TRID abstract says the report forms part of an Argentine draft standard, gives cross-sections and analyses four beam types; the abstract does not expose their dimensions.
records.missing_information: Locate the Spanish conference proceedings or scan, translate the four cross-section tables/figures and establish whether the draft standard entered practice or was superseded.
records.contact_route: TRID accession 01298969; Argentine Road and Traffic Congress archives

records.organisation: Philippine Department of Public Works and Highways / Environmental Management Bureau
records.title_original: Laguna Lakeshore Road Network Infrastructure Preparation and Innovation Facility Output 1
records.title_en: Laguna Lakeshore Road Network EIS: AASHTO Type VI and NU 2000 girder alternatives
records.locator: PDF p.65, section 1.4.6.5 and Figures 1-48/1-49: 40 m AASHTO Type VI option and 45 m NU 2000 option
records.printed_dimensions: The authority EIS says AASHTO girders are commonly used in the Philippines, proposes AASHTO Type VI at 40 m and NU 2000 at 45 m, and describes NU as newly introduced on Cebu-Cordova. The figure outlines were not directly retrieved because the host returned HTTP 403.
records.missing_information: Retrieve Figures 1-48/1-49 or the structural annex, inspect both complete outlines and compare the Type VI drawing with the US PCI reference and the DPWH project drawing already queued.
